title: Compiled person registry row
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/taxonomy/persons.parquet. Compiled from taxonomy/person_aliases.json plus dim_persons self-aliases. This registry is the person-identity surface shared by elections and governments.

x-changelog.description: Initial S.1 compiled person registry schema. Day-one rows are self-aliases from dim_persons; future merge clusters add cluster_id and merged_candidacy_count > 1.

person_id.description: PK. Layer-1 or merged ADR-0035 person id.

source_id.description: FK -> taxonomy/sources.parquet supporting the identity row.

cluster_id.description: Source merge-overlay cluster id, or null for Layer-1 self-alias rows.

merged_candidacy_count.description: Number of candidacy keys represented by this identity row.
